item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":40,"statement":"`LM.__init__` treats model names matching `o1`, `o3`, `o4`, or `o5` with optional `-mini`/`-nano`/`-pro` and optional date suffixes, plus `gpt-5*` names except `gpt-5-chat`, as reasoning models.","span_ids":["s1","s2","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"For those reasoning models, construction fails unless `temperature` is `1.0` or `None` and `max_tokens` is at least `16000` or `None`.","span_ids":["s1","s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Accepted reasoning models store the token limit under `max_completion_tokens` in `lm.kwargs`, not `max_tokens`.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"Non-matching models, including `gpt-5-chat`, skip the reasoning-model branch and keep plain `max_tokens` in `lm.kwargs`.","span_ids":["s1","s4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":87,"end_line":109},{"span_id":"s2","path":"tests/clients/test_lm.py","start_line":306,"end_line":334},{"span_id":"s3","path":"tests/clients/test_lm.py","start_line":337,"end_line":363},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/clients/test_lm.py","start_line":366,"end_line":378}]}
